connector.name: Dbgprobe MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Let AI agents interact with debug probes - connect, flash, read/write memory, and reset.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package dbgprobe-mcp-server. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the es617 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: DBGPROBE_BACKEND
env.description: Debug probe backend to use (default: jlink). Future: openocd, pyocd.

env.name: DBGPROBE_MCP_LOG_LEVEL
env.description: Log level: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING (default), ERROR.

env.name: DBGPROBE_JLINK_PATH
env.description: Explicit path to JLinkExe (or JLink.exe on Windows). Auto-detected if not set.

env.name: DBGPROBE_JLINK_GDBSERVER_PATH
env.description: Explicit path to JLinkGDBServerCLExe. Auto-detected if not set.

env.name: DBGPROBE_JLINK_DEVICE
env.description: Default target device string (e.g. nRF52840_xxAA). Can be overridden per-session.

env.name: DBGPROBE_MCP_PLUGINS
env.description: Plugin policy: 'all' or comma-separated plugin names. Unset = disabled.

env.name: DBGPROBE_MCP_TOOL_SEPARATOR
env.description: Tool name separator character (default '.'). Set to '_' for clients that reject dots (e.g. Cursor).
